text: dsh-iridescent-model-selector 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的模型选择插件。它接入会话输入区的模型插槽，以自定义面板替换当前模型按钮。用户可以按提供方浏览或搜索模型、收藏常用模型，并调整模型支持的思考程度；每个模型的上次档位会在浏览器本地记住。适合需要在对话中快速切换模型与推理档位的 DSH 网页用户。

dsh-iridescent-model-selector adds a model picker to the DSH web composer. Users can browse or search models, save favorites, and adjust supported reasoning effort. The browser remembers favorites and each model’s last effort level, making model changes easier during a conversation.
想在 DSH 对话输入框里快速切换模型。
有没有办法把常用模型收藏起来，之后更快找到？
I want to adjust a model’s reasoning effort from the DSH composer.
dsh-iridescent-model-selector 的功能「切换模型」：打开输入区的模型面板，可按提供方浏览模型；模型超过四个时可搜索。点击模型后通过会话模型目录应用选择。
dsh-iridescent-model-selector 的功能「收藏与思考档位」：可将模型加入收藏，并为支持该能力的模型调整思考程度；收藏和每个模型最近使用的档位保存在浏览器 localStorage。

dsh-iridescent-model-selector README · dsh-iridescent-model-selector：English | [中文](README.zh.md) A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) client plugin that replaces the model button in the composer with its own picker: the current model and reasoning effort sit on the button, and one panel holds the model list, your favorite models, and a reasoning-effort slider.

dsh-iridescent-model-selector README · Features：- **Direct model picking.** One panel lists every model from the harness's own model catalog, grouped by provider. A search field appears when more than four models are available. Clicking a row switches the session's model for the next request and keeps the panel open, so you can adjust the reasoning effort in the same pass.
- **Favorites.** Hover a row and click the star to pin a model to a Favorites group at the top of the list. Up to 24 favorites are kept in the browser's local storage.
- **Reasoning-effort slider.** The slider has one stop for each effort level the selected model advertises. A continuous aurora gradient (cyan → blue → violet → rose) reveals more of its spectrum at higher levels, with a glow and a light sweep that grow with the level. Release the thumb or click a level name to apply it.
- **Per-model effort memory.** The last effort you used with each provider/model pair is restored when you switch back to that model, if the model still offers it.
- **Native fallback.** The plugin takes the composer's model seat at a higher priority instead of removing the built-in selector. The built-in selector stays registered

dsh-iridescent-model-selector README · Compatibility：Tested on **DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 and 0.2.1-rc.5** (`engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`).

The plugin reads the per-session model directory (`modelDirectories`) that the built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` plugin provides. That service is an internal detail of the harness, so a later harness release can change it. Keep the built-in model-selection plugin enabled; this plugin does nothing without it.

dsh-iridescent-model-selector README · Install：Web (`dsh web`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/JackieJam/dsh-iridescent-model-selector.git
```

Desktop: install from the same Git URL through the app's plugin manager (or a plugin market such as dsh-market once it lists this plugin).

To go back to the built-in selector, disable or uninstall the plugin.

dsh-iridescent-model-selector README · Notes：- Model and effort changes go through the harness's normal session model selection. A step that is already running keeps the model and effort it started with.
- Favorites and remembered efforts live in the browser's `localStorage` for the DSH page, so they are per machine and are not synced.
